name: Lor'themar Theron
summary: Lor'themar Theron is the Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas, entrusted with governing the ruined kingdom of the blood elves while Prince Kael'thas is away. A veteran ranger lord and former second-in-command to Ranger-General Sylvanas Windrunner, he bears the heavy burden of keeping his shattered people alive in the wake of the Scourge invasion.

sections.title: From Ranger Lord to Regent
sections.body: Before the Third War, Lor'themar Theron spent centuries serving as a decorated commander of the Farstriders, defending the northern elven borders against the Amani trolls and rising to become second-in-command to Ranger-General Sylvanas Windrunner. When Arthas and the Scourge decimated Quel'Thalas and destroyed the Sunwell, Lor'themar was among the surviving veterans who rallied the living remnants. When Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider departed for the south—and eventually into the unknown seeking a cure for their people's devastating addiction to magic—he named Lor'themar Regent Lord to safeguard the kingdom in his absence.

sections.title: The Weight of the Sunstriders
sections.body: Lor'themar never sought the crown or the political labyrinth of elven nobility. By instinct, he remains a scout and a soldier who prefers a bow and plain orders to courtly diplomacy. Yet with the Sunstrider dynasty abroad and Quel'Thalas surrounded by undead prowling the Ghostlands, Theron oversees the grueling day-to-day survival of the blood elves. His duties frequently bring diplomatic entanglements with the kingdom's former defender, now the Banshee Queen ruling Undercity, whose aid the desperate survivors of Quel'Thalas find difficult to refuse.

faq.answer: He is the Regent Lord of Quel'Thalas and leader of the blood elves remaining in Azeroth. Formerly the second-in-command of the Farstriders under Sylvanas Windrunner, he was granted leadership of the homeland by Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider.

faq.q: What is his relationship with Sylvanas Windrunner?
faq.answer: Lor'themar served as Sylvanas's trusted second-in-command during her life as Ranger-General of Silvermoon. Though they were longtime comrades in the Farstriders, her death, transformation into a banshee, and rule over the Forsaken have made their current relationship far more complicated and guarded.

faq.q: Is Lor'themar the king of the blood elves?
faq.answer: No. Lor'themar holds the title of Regent Lord, governing in the name of Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider, who remains the rightful monarch and leader of the sin'dorei while away seeking a remedy for their arcane withdrawal.

faq.q: What military background does he have?
faq.answer: He is a veteran ranger lord who fought in the Second War against the Old Horde and Amani trolls, and served as a warden of the Sunwell. He spent centuries leading Farstrider companies before politics forced him into rulership.

angles.text: Forsaken travelers often remember that Sylvanas Windrunner's former comrades still breathe in the ruined north, with Lor'themar serving as the fragile bridge between Silvermoon and the Dark Lady's realm.
To marksmanship veterans and scouts, Lor'themar represents the pinnacle of the Farstrider tradition—a master marksman thrust from forest patrols into the burden of statecraft.
